note: The check suite (plans/2026-11-01-check-suite.md, owner approved 2026-11-01): one short, fixed task list for every candidate setting, template or model, run as a paired campaign against its baseline. `slots` fill from the mined fixes (E3) and the Blender tasks (E5) once they pass E4 and E6; until then the suite runs `tasks`. The document tasks are sized by Strata's tokenizer and run on Strata only, so the second long-context task is depth-tool-call-late.
